This '''ice field''' was a body of frozen [[Water/Legends|water]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Count Dooku's frigate/Legends|Count Dooku's frigate]] was present in it when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] let himself be [[Skirmish at Vanqor/Legends|captured]] by the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] in order to locate and capture [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].
